description: Java class defining shell commands for managing sensor devices, including listing, adding, faulting, tampering, and checking in sensors within a mock Zigbee core environment.

classes.name: SensorDeviceShell
classes.description: Shell commands for managing sensor devices in a mock Zigbee environment.

classes.name: SensorDeviceShell.NameValueProvider
classes.description: Provides device names for legacy door/window sensors within shell commands.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all sensors with their details in a table format.

methods.name: addSensor
methods.description: Adds a new IASSensor with a specified or default name.

methods.name: addLegacySensor
methods.description: Adds a new legacy door/window sensor with a specified or default name.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sets a specified sensor as faulted.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a specified sensor from faulted state.

methods.name: faultToggle
methods.description: Toggles the faulted state of a specified sensor.

methods.name: tamper
methods.description: Marks a specified sensor as tampered.

methods.name: tamperRestore
methods.description: Restores tampered status of a specified sensor.

methods.name: tamperToggle
methods.description: Toggles the tampered status of a specified sensor.

methods.name: lowBattery
methods.description: Marks a specified sensor as having low battery.

methods.name: lowBatteryRestore
methods.description: Restores low battery status of a specified sensor.

methods.name: lowBatteryToggle
methods.description: Toggles the low battery status of a specified sensor.

methods.name: sendCheckin
methods.description: Triggers a poll control check-in for a specified sensor.
